purpose: Verify complete successful progression of Club Membership Enrollment workflow (BW-GYM-01)
preconditions: Confirmed club exists with coordinator 101, student 301 has no existing application
action_or_input: Step 1: Student 301 calls apply_club_membership; Step 2: Coordinator 101 calls approve_club_membership
expected_result: Step 1 yields status 'open'; Step 2 transitions status to 'confirmed'

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-01 transition 1 guard blocks membership application when club is unconfirmed
action_or_input: Student 301 calls apply_club_membership on the open club
expected_result: Application rejected with ValueError; workflow does not start

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-01 transition 1 guard blocks duplicate same-club membership application
preconditions: Student 301 has an open membership application in confirmed club
action_or_input: Student 301 calls apply_club_membership again for the same club
expected_result: Operation rejected with ValueError; application state remains single open application

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-01 transition 2 guard blocks membership approval by non-coordinator
preconditions: Open membership application exists for club
expected_result: Rejected with PermissionError; membership remains in 'open' status

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-01 transition 2 guard blocks re-approval of an already confirmed application
preconditions: Membership application has already reached 'confirmed' status
action_or_input: Coordinator 101 calls approve_club_membership on the confirmed application
expected_result: Rejected with ValueError; state remains confirmed

purpose: Verify complete successful progression of Targeted Poll Participation workflow (BW-GYM-02)
action_or_input: Step 1: Coordinator 101 creates poll with 2 choices and target batch '2024'; Step 2: Student 301 in batch '2024' casts vote
expected_result: Step 1 creates active poll; Step 2 records vote in poll tally

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-02 transition 1 guard blocks poll creation by non-coordinator
expected_result: Rejected with PermissionError; poll is not created

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-02 transition 1 guard blocks poll creation with fewer than 2 choices
expected_result: Rejected with ValueError; poll is not created

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-02 transition 2 guard blocks voting when poll has expired
preconditions: Active poll was created, but expires_at has passed
action_or_input: Targeted student attempts to cast vote in the expired poll
expected_result: Vote rejected with ValueError; tally unchanged

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-02 transition 2 guard blocks voting when student does not match target audience
preconditions: Poll targets batch '2024', student 302 is in batch '2025'
expected_result: Vote rejected with ValueError; tally unchanged

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-02 transition 2 guard blocks duplicate vote by same student in same poll
preconditions: Student 301 has already voted in active poll
action_or_input: Student 301 calls cast_poll_vote a second time
expected_result: Vote rejected with ValueError; second vote not recorded

purpose: Verify complete successful progression of Club Establishment and Confirmation workflow (BW-GYM-03)
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated, valid student leaders and faculty councillor available
action_or_input: Step 1: Call create_club -> Club Open; Step 2: Call confirm_club -> Club Confirmed
expected_result: Club created with status 'open' and then confirmed with status 'confirmed'

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-03 transition 1 guard blocks club creation when student leaders are invalid
action_or_input: Call create_club with invalid student ID (<= 0) or same coordinator & co-coordinator
expected_result: Rejected with ValueError; club not created

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-03 transition 1 guard blocks club creation when faculty councillor is invalid
action_or_input: Call create_club with invalid faculty councillor ID (<= 0)
expected_result: Rejected with ValueError; club not created

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-03 transition 1 guard blocks club creation when category is not allowed
expected_result: Rejected with ValueError; club not created

purpose: Verify BW-GYM-03 transition 2 guard blocks re-approval of an already confirmed club
action_or_input: Call confirm_club on the confirmed club
expected_result: Rejected with ValueError; club status remains 'confirmed'
